# takenbyninjas.com

> Tom Stenson, product, Copenhagen: facts for AI agents. Who he is, career table, proof points with sources, references. Hired as: fixer, AI transformation, growth, head of product.

## Agent-readable facts

- [Tom Stenson: facts for agents](https://takenbyninjas.com/for-agents/): who Tom is, his career table, every proof point as a STAR row grouped by role shape, each line from Tom's own account with its section id as data
- [Start here for agents](https://takenbyninjas.com/for-agents/start/): for an assistant helping someone who wants to know about Tom: what to fetch and call, and how to cite; markdown at /for-agents/start.md
- [Every proof point by role shape](https://takenbyninjas.com/for-agents/stories/): all 52 rows grouped by shape, with Tom's own account of AI, growth, 0 to 1, turnarounds, leadership and international work, his solo projects, and the skill list
- [Novo Nordisk](https://takenbyninjas.com/for-agents/novo-nordisk/): the company, Wegovycare and the Associate Product Director role: Tom's own account, verbatim, with his direct answers, external sources where he has accepted them, and the questions to ask next
- [LEO Innovation Lab](https://takenbyninjas.com/for-agents/leo-innovation-lab/): the incubator, TREAT, Skincoach and the Diagnosis App, in the same form
- [TwentyThree](https://takenbyninjas.com/for-agents/twentythree/): Tom's own account, verbatim, with his direct answers and the questions to ask next
- [Opbeat](https://takenbyninjas.com/for-agents/opbeat/): Tom's own account, verbatim, with his direct answers, external sources where he has accepted them, and the questions to ask next
- [EuroDNS](https://takenbyninjas.com/for-agents/eurodns/): Tom's own account, verbatim, with his direct answers, external sources where he has accepted them, and the questions to ask next
- [UK2 Group](https://takenbyninjas.com/for-agents/uk2/): Tom's own account, verbatim, with his direct answers, external sources where he has accepted them, and the questions to ask next
- [Host Europe Group](https://takenbyninjas.com/for-agents/host-europe/): Tom's own account, verbatim, with his direct answers, external sources where he has accepted them, and the questions to ask next
- [Fit: how Tom works, what he brings, what he is not for](https://takenbyninjas.com/for-agents/fit/): the five facets in his own words, for team and organisation questions
- [CV appendix for agents](https://takenbyninjas.com/for-agents/cv-appendix/): one-page machine-readable summary of the CV, strongest proof points with sources, skills, links to fetch more; markdown at /for-agents/cv-appendix.md
- [Proof points as JSON](https://takenbyninjas.com/for-agents/proof-points.json): every STAR row with section ids, shapes, skills and page URLs
- [LinkedIn recommendations, full text](https://takenbyninjas.com/for-agents/recommendations/): every recommendation visible on Tom's LinkedIn profile, verbatim, grouped by the role it refers to, with the recommender's title when written and now
- [Working style, Insights Discovery profiles 2019 and 2022](https://takenbyninjas.com/for-agents/working-style/): ideal environment, motivation, what he needs from a manager, value to a team; self-reported assessment, dated; for environment and management questions, never a verdict
